issue: scripts/03_step1_sampling.py computes the 'true population std' with ddof=1 (1.077912) while scripts/04_step2_clt_ci.py computes 'true population sigma' with ddof=0 (1.077821) for the same conceptual quantity -- numerically negligible at n=5928 but methodologically inconsistent
recommended_fix: Standardize on ddof=0 for any value explicitly labeled a true population parameter; reserve ddof=1 for genuine sample statistics.
